newsitem.title: USA: Times Mirror sells $435 million notes.
newsitem.headline: Times Mirror sells $435 million notes.

text.p: Times Mirror Co said Thursday it had sold $435 million of 20-year liquid yield option notes due 2017.
The LYONs, which are zero-coupon subordinated notes, were priced with a yield to maturity of 4.75 percent, resulting in gross proceeds to the company of $170.1 million.
The LYONs are convertible into a maximum of 2,535,180 shares of Times Mirror Series A common stock at an initial conversion price of $67.10.
The LYONs are redeemable in cash by the company at any time on or after April 15, 2002.
The company has granted to Merrill Lynch an option to purchase up to $65 million face amount of additional LYONs solely for the purpose of covering over-allotments.
